text: I brought this to my book club last month and it sparked one of the best discussions we've had all year. The confession structure pulls you through -- you know something terrible is coming and you can't stop reading. The foxfire, the glowing house, that image stuck with me for days. My one complaint is the pacing in the middle section about the mining. It's beautifully written but it goes on longer than it needs to. By the time we get to Nola I was ready to move forward. But that ending -- the unfinished sentence, the shark tooth in the closet -- I actually got chills. Several of us did.
